d: Room in the building of Corrado. In front of magnificent gallery that leads to rich apartments. Adelia sitting at a coffee table, Odetta and Damigelle surround her bringing various ornaments.
Rugged from the bottom, and said.
Knights' Choir, and said.
Military band, Knights, Shields, Soldiers. After the courting Corrado comes out in the middle of Adelia and Ruggiero.
Aladdin, Emma with Paggi, Scudieri, etc.
Ruggiero and Aladdin.
Apartments, Emma alone.
Aladdin is said, then Ruggiero.
Emma and Ruggiero.
Corrado, Adelia and the like
Odesi glad music from afar, and voices of praise. Then they approach Knights, Dames, Paggi, Scudieri, all festive and happy.

Internal atrium of the Palazzo di Corrado with large arches and colonnades on the front. Of a façade a staircase that puts to practicable galleries, which lead to apartments illuminated inside. Two stairs from the sides for which you vassi to different parts of the palace. It is night. Music expresses a feast. Aladdin descends from the staircase in front.
They descend from the stairs in front of Knights, Dames, Trovadori, and Menestrelli. They sit in the lobby, and sing the following farewell to the spouses.
Emma descends from the stairs to the left. She approaches the agitated and lost scene. Aladdin returns and follows her with great anxiety. Emma is standing before him.
Ruggiero from the left staircase preceded by a Scudiero: he is wrapped in a broad cloak.
Corrado is in the midst of them, and with a thundering voice he cries out:
Damigelle, Scudieri and Cavalieri, come from all over the world, then Adelia pale and lost as a resigned and scattered hair. Gradually the scene is populated by spectators.

Gallery - at the bottom large closed windows, which then open and let you see the sea and the port of Tyre. From the sides apartments. It is dawn. Damigelle, Scudieri who come and go from the various apartments: Dame and Knights who speak softly to each other.
Corrado, and sayings.
Ruggiero and Corrado.
Ruggiero, go to Emma.
Emma alone, go to Aladdin.
Emma alone.
Adelia held by the damsel and said.
Adelia and Damigelle, then Corrado.
Bridesmaids coming back, the scene gets sick of people rushing.
